name: Data Platform VS Code Control Plane

authority.note: This is not the Datapass Workbench product. It is a developer control plane for VS Code.

objective: Provide one VS Code-native control panel for project context, platform navigation, tool discovery, status and safe command orchestration across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks, infrastructure and project-specific profiles such as FOIL.

architecture_decision.separate_extension_rule: Split a domain into a separate VSIX only if it needs an independent release/security boundary, incompatible activation/runtime dependencies, or standalone distribution to users who do not need the core shell.
architecture_decision.vendor_rule: Do not rebuild vendor/community capabilities that already exist. Detect, launch and compose supported extensions/CLIs/APIs instead.
architecture_decision.project_rule: Project-specific logic is a profile/adapter. It may live in a separate repo, but it must not become a second vendor client stack.
architecture_decision.specialized_ui_rule: Keep genuinely specialized heavy UI tools external when VS Code adds little value; launch them from the control plane when useful.

responsibility: links to source repos, docs and runbooks

layers.rule: Adapters contain integration logic, not duplicated vendor implementations.
Official/community extensions remain independently installed and usable. The control plane may detect and invoke documented VS Code commands when stable.
Libraries, CLIs, PowerShell modules and SDKs are invoked through tasks/terminals/scripts or project workflows; they do not require a wrapper extension by default.
Profiles bind project repositories, environments, runbooks and allowed actions to the generic adapters.

capabilities_observed: programmatic item workflows and Git-oriented developer experience
tools.control_plane_role: Primary Microsoft-supported VS Code integration. The Fabric adapter complements it with project context, CLI/CI-CD actions and curated toolbox capabilities.
Detect installation; provide open/focus shortcuts and project-scoped entry points. Do not recreate its workspace browser.

capabilities_observed: browse OneLake in VS Code Explorer
tools.control_plane_role: Expose OneLake entry points from Fabric projects; do not build another OneLake explorer.
Preferred command surface for many Fabric adapter actions; run through VS Code tasks/terminals and parse structured results where appropriate.
Maintain a curated catalog of relevant accelerators/actions with provenance; surface only tools that solve a current project need.

capabilities_observed: code-first CI/CD for source-controlled Fabric workspaces
deployment automation without direct REST API handling by the caller
tools.control_plane_role: Run or scaffold project CI/CD tasks; no separate VS Code extension required.

capabilities_observed: remote hosting and job scheduling support
tools.control_plane_role: Surface as a Fabric workload-development path/template. Do not confuse a Fabric workload extension with a VS Code extension.
Treat as a source of useful Fabric/Data Engineering tools. Promote individual capabilities only after inspecting and testing them.
Keep as donor/history. Migrate only proven useful actions into the Fabric adapter or keep them as callable scripts/tools.
Do not develop a second standalone Fabric toolbox extension unless an independent distribution boundary later appears.

integration_depth.principle: Integrate Fabric more deeply without rebuilding Fabric clients.

levels.behavior: Detect installation, focus/open views, invoke documented commands where stable.
Expose project-aware VS Code commands/tasks for auth, validate, import/export, deploy and CI/CD.
Index selected assets in a manifest and expose Open, Clone, Scaffold, Run, Deploy or Read actions according to asset type.
Launch/scaffold a separate Fabric workload project when the desired feature belongs inside Fabric itself.

integration_depth.split_trigger: Only split the Fabric adapter into a separate VSIX if it later needs independent distribution, security/auth isolation, incompatible dependencies or a materially different release lifecycle.

capabilities_observed: Power BI and Fabric agent skills/plugins
tools.control_plane_role: Detect/document optional agentic tooling and launch setup/runbook actions. Do not copy the marketplace into the VS Code extension.
Useful knowledge/examples for report development; not a VS Code extension.
Keep specialized model/report engineering code as donor. Move generic navigation/orchestration into VS Code; retain external UI only where it materially beats VS Code.
Launch/integrate where useful; do not force advanced TOM/model editing into the generic control panel.
Detect/open/focus and complement with project-specific commands rather than fork.

capabilities_observed: uses Databricks CLI/Azure tooling for some authentication flows
tools.control_plane_role: Optional task provider for PowerShell-oriented admin/automation; not the primary Databricks client.
Do not continue as the main FOIL path; current package identity collides with the official Databricks extension.
FOIL profile points to this repo for Databricks bundle/run workflows.

tools.name: OpenTofu
tools.control_plane_role: Keep language/editor support in the peer extension; the control plane runs project-specific tofu workflows.

infrastructure.control_plane_role: Show project-specific infrastructure status and shortcuts; do not implement Terraform/OpenTofu/Kubernetes/SSH clients.

oracle_vm.boundary: Use Remote SSH/terminal/OCI CLI or supported APIs for low-level operations.

tools.name: gcx
tools.control_plane_role: Expose Grafana context, preview, validate, pull/push and environment commands. Treat grafanactl as deprecated.

tools.name: Grafana Foundation SDK
tools.control_plane_role: Scaffold and run typed dashboard generators stored in Git.

tools.name: Grafana Terraform provider
tools.control_plane_role: Deploy/manage dashboards and broader Grafana resources through the infrastructure adapter.

tools.name: Grafana Git Sync
tools.control_plane_role: Offer as an alternative to direct CLI/IaC deployment for Git-native dashboard workflows.

tools.name: Grafana Cloud MCP
tools.control_plane_role: Optional agentic observability integration; not required for the core VS Code workflow.

tools.name: Grafana k6 VS Code extension
tools.control_plane_role: Use for k6 performance-test authoring/runs; do not treat it as a general Grafana dashboard extension.

example_flow: gcx dev serve for local/live preview
OpenTofu/Terraform provider, gcx push or Git Sync for deployment

foil.target_role: FOIL project adapter/profile for the global VS Code control plane
notes: FOIL Project Management/Mongo remains routing and durable project state.
The FOIL adapter should open/call Fabric, Databricks, infrastructure and other tools needed by the current FOIL task.
